set.body:
Supporting track: Run. The last check before people try a journey. If this passes, we believe the journeys will.

Acceptance
1. The core gate (CORE) is closed, and the pilot instance (RUN2) runs on the pilot host (RUN1).
2. The four journey scripts (CORE1) pass on the pilot host three times in a row, against the deployed service, with the pilot-sized study from CORE3.
3. Last night's backup ran, and the scripted restore drill (RUN3) passes on the pilot host.
4. The screens the journeys need are built and their console checks are green: SEE4, SHARE1, IN7 and OPEN6.
5. A note here says ready, with the commit and the date. Only then are people invited.
set.title: RUN5: Pre-flight: the journey scripts pass on the pilot host before anyone is invited
